trello.name: Send final DataBridge renewal terms request and escalate to legal if no reply
trello.desc: Sofia sends one final plain-language email to DataBridge's account manager today requesting revised terms by Thursday close of business. If no reply is received by Thursday COB, Sofia escalates to legal on Friday morning to review termination-for-convenience options. The contract lapses August 29th.

trello.name: Request Dana to review security audit cryptography and key management findings
trello.desc: Sofia messages Dana (platform team) today, framing the request as coming from Ravi, asking her to review sections 4 and 6 of the 60-page external security audit report covering cryptography and key management findings. Dana should send her assessment to this group before the next sync in two weeks. If Dana lacks bandwidth, Ravi will take it to her manager.

trello.name: Add logo decision entry to rebrand FAQ
trello.desc: Tomas adds a line to the rebrand FAQ stating the March decision that the logo stays as-is and only the color palette is being refreshed, including a link to the March meeting notes. To be completed this week.
